notes: Machine-readable index of faion workflows. The faion umbrella SKILL.md auto-routes user intent to one of these by matching `triggers` keywords. Each workflow folder follows the workflow-spec at .aidocs/conventions/workflows/workflow-spec.md.

schema.title: Display title
schema.triggers: List of keyword phrases that should auto-route to this workflow

brainstorm.title: Brainstorm
brainstorm.summary: Multi-agent diverge-converge-review for ideation, technical audits, and improvement plans. Distinct personas in independent generation prevent anchoring; adversarial reviewers prevent rubber-stamping.
brainstorm.notes: Phase 0 CONSENT GATE: if the orchestrator triggered brainstorm but the user did not explicitly request it, MUST use the platform user-choice primitive before launching agents. Defaults: 10 research + 8 reviewers, max 3 parallel, 30 recs/agent. Phase 1 emits the four-field shape as a terminal pass (freeform reasoning first); externally-grounded personas carry per-claim source + H/M/L confidence; orchestrator range-checks the consensus count.

improver.title: Improver
improver.summary: Session-first continuous improvement. Phase 0 (session review) runs on every invocation and appends PAT/ERR/DEC entries to .aidocs/memory/. Phases 1-7 are optional extensions.
improver.notes: Phase 0 always runs first. Phase 3.5 is mandatory before any write — even CRITICAL findings cannot bypass user approval. Phase 4b routes project-scope findings through SDD planning. Audit / fix intents run the project's existing validators before dispatching any investigation subagent. ERR entries record `rung:` (cheapest catching instrument) and a `check:` when rung is 1-2.

media-ops.title: Media-Ops
media-ops.summary: Build a complete AI media publishing pipeline from scratch (TG channel + site + automation). 7 phases: discovery interview, propose format, scaffold project, setup infrastructure, seed content, register in media-manager, iterate. Pattern proven in 4 production outlets.
media-ops.notes: Reference impls: neromedia (8 langs), pashtelka (UA), longlife (UA), ender (UA+EN). Cron lives centrally in media-manager — never schedule per-outlet. Image-required rule: no TG post without an image. Visual-automation platforms (n8n, Make, Dify, Flowise) are rejected as schedulers or publishers — media-manager is the only unattended trigger surface.

poll-agents.title: Poll-Agents
poll-agents.summary: Self-replenishing pool of N background subagents draining a queue of independent task batches. Parent does only orchestration; all writes happen in isolated worktree subagents. Two-signal replenishment: cron tick + completion handler.
poll-agents.notes: Hard rule: parent does NOT do research/writes/commits/merges. Strict 15-in-flight cap default. State: QUEUE.txt + DONE.txt + mandatory ACTIVE.txt (marker written BEFORE dispatch; `done=` slug must be in the in-flight set; stale entries dead-lettered, never silently re-dispatched). On batch failure, retry-with-sonnet (not haiku). Battle-tested at feature-045 (1142 methodologies) and feature-048 (120 playbooks). Prompt caching does not apply to Agent-tool dispatches — size fan-out as full-rate uncached input.

sdd-batch-orchestrator.title: SDD Batch Orchestrator
sdd-batch-orchestrator.summary: Orchestration pattern for delivering a batch of related SDD features end-to-end inside one agent session: study .aidocs/ features → clarify → plan → wave-execute in worktrees → verify → review → fix → visual-deliver → close.
sdd-batch-orchestrator.notes: Also fits single-feature SDD work (smaller scope, same phases). Primary execution path for feature-048 (120 tier playbooks). decisions.xml covers phase-count, versioned prompt files, worktree-isolated waves, flock-serialized merge, hard-capped review-fix loop, visual-deliver phase, per-surface playbook adaptation. v2.1.0 adds an EXECUTE entry gate on unresolved clarification markers, a blocker-must-cite-spec-or-constitution rule, a one-shot convergence re-derivation after the first REVIEW PASS (writes only new TASK_*.md), and the freeform-body + validated-last-line output contract. v2.2.0 introduces the three-role split: the orchestrator is the main thread (its contract is templates/orchestrator-approach.md — the one role with no prompt file), the coordinator is an independent wave-boundary gate returning CLEAR/HOLD/ABORT that may check but never fix, and executors stay one-prompt-file-per-phase. The phase list stays at twelve; prompts 13-14 front the coordinator and the ledger auditor. Reflection is an append-only action ledger written at wave boundaries with cited evidence and audited before the next batch's INTAKE.

idea-to-prod.title: Idea-to-Prod
idea-to-prod.summary: Single-prompt autonomous build from idea to production. Cron-driven loop on a fixed .product/ file layout (master-prompt + state + decisions + tasks + research). Six phases: research → brainstorm → SDD plan → implement → deploy → validate. Composes sibling /faion workflows by name.
idea-to-prod.notes: Umbrella shape, not a content store: composes sibling workflows (brainstorm Phase 2, sdd-batch-orchestrator Phases 3-4, optional improver post-Phase-6). Cron tick is heartbeat (drain detection + post-compaction recovery), NOT control flow — orchestrator drives iterations continuously. Phase 5 deploy gate requires explicit operator approval via platform user-choice primitive (irreversible-action boundary). Project layout `.product/` (master-prompt + state + decisions + tasks + research) is the workflow's contract; project content is project-specific. Subagent dispatch is by file reference (master-prompt path + task-brief path), never inline-pasted prompts. Decision log is append-only with chosen-vs-rejected pairs. v1.1.0: Phase 2.5 concept gate (PRFAQ verdict proceed|revise|kill; kill is a successful terminal stop). Phase 3 writes the current SDD artifact set (spec.md, plan.md with ## Design + ## Execution Plan, conditional user-flows.md / ui-ux-design.md, TASK_*.md, readiness.md) — design.md / test-plan.md / implementation-plan.md are retired names. Phase 6 validates cheapest-instrument-first with model-graded scenarios capped at 5-15. Per-directory docs: CLAUDE.md one-liner mandatory, AGENTS.md is a capped human-confirmed stub, never auto-generated prose.
